lines: 叶凡进入混沌空间第三层。
一个血红色的龙形石碑，漂浮在半空中，石碑上刻着血红色的文字！
叶凡靠近一看，几个大字映入眼帘：《龙血霸体诀》
“武者可觉醒龙血之力！霸体状态，刀枪不入、万法不侵！”
“一共九层，随着境界提升，霸体的时间随之延长！”
“第一层，霸体时间一息！”
“第二层，五息……”
叶凡看完介绍。
心中不由激动起来，一息大概等于一秒钟左右，如果生死关头，无敌一秒钟，相当于保住一条命。
第二层，无敌五秒钟！可以直接改变战局。
叶凡激动的问：“混沌万物鼎，这是什么等级的武技？”
这个世界，武者修炼的功法，也叫武技。
武技分为：人级、黄级、玄级、地级、天级。
按照‘天地玄黄人’五个等级划分，每一级分三品。
天级之上，据说还有神级武技，但叶凡从未听说过任何一种神级武技的名字！
也许整个大夏皇朝，都未必有一本神级武技！
“没有等级！”
“什么？没有等级？”
“你们这个世界，创造不出这种功法，所以无法分级！”
“那《吸功大法》呢？”
“没有等级。”
依旧是这个答案。
叶凡惊的张开嘴巴。
难道混沌万物鼎的奖励，都不是这个世界的功法？更高层次的武道世界吗？
“管他这么多，炼！”
叶凡直接开始修炼《龙血霸体诀》！
心法运行的瞬间！
叶凡的脑海中传来一声龙吟！
“混沌万物鼎，你听到了吗？”
叶凡一惊。
混沌万物鼎解释：“这是龙吟声，你修炼此功法，血液在武脉中流动，便会发出阵阵龙吟声！”
“若你实力提升，每一次出手，还会爆发血龙幻象！”
大夏皇宫，后宫某座宫殿内。
“叶凡没死？”
消息传回来后，李幽若很失望。
content_en:
Ye Fan entered the third level of chaotic space.
A blood-red dragon-shaped stone tablet floats in mid-air, with blood-red words engraved on it!
Ye Fan took a closer look, and several big characters came into view: "Dragon Blood Hegemony Body Technique"
"Warriors can awaken the power of dragon blood! In the domineering state, they are invulnerable to all weapons and weapons!"
"There are nine levels in total. As the level increases, the time of dominating the body will be extended!"
"The first level, one breath of domineering body time!"
"Second level, five breaths..."
Ye Fan finished reading the introduction.
I couldn't help but feel excited. One breath was equal to about one second. If it was a life-and-death situation, being invincible for one second was equivalent to saving a life.
Second level, invincible for five seconds! It can directly change the situation of the battle.
Ye Fan asked excitedly: "Chaos Cauldron of All Things, what level of martial arts is this?"
In this world, the techniques practiced by warriors are also called martial arts.
Martial skills are divided into: human level, yellow level, mysterious level, earth level, and heaven level.
According to the five levels of 'Heaven and Earth Xuanhuang people', each level is divided into three grades.
Above the heaven level, it is said that there are god-level martial arts, but Ye Fan has never heard the name of any god-level martial arts!
Maybe the entire Daxia Dynasty may not have a god-level martial arts!
"No hierarchy!"
"What? No level?"
"Your world cannot create this kind of skill, so it cannot be classified!"
"What about the "Absorbing Gong Dafa"?"
"There is no hierarchy."
Still the answer.
Ye Fan opened his mouth in shock.
Could it be that the rewards from the Chaos Cauldron of All Things are not the techniques of this world? A higher level of martial arts world?
"No matter what, Lian!"
Ye Fan directly started practicing the "Dragon Blood Hegemony Body Technique"!
The moment when the mind works!
"Ouch--!"
A dragon roar came from Ye Fan's mind!
"Chaos Cauldron of All Things, did you hear it?"
Ye Fan was shocked.
The Cauldron of Chaos Everything explained: "This is the sound of dragon roars. When you practice this technique, the blood will flow in the martial veins, and bursts of dragon roars will be emitted!"
"If your strength increases, every time you take action, the illusion of the blood dragon will erupt!"
…
Daxia Palace, in a certain palace in the harem.
"Evan is not dead?"
After the news came back, Li Youruo was very disappointed.
